title: URL Rewriting: Redirect and Rewrite Requests | Orchard Core
description:
A renamed page or a moved folder leaves old addresses in bookmarks, search results and links on other sites. Visitors who follow them need to reach the right content.

The URL Rewriting feature of Orchard Core redirects or rewrites incoming requests with rules that you manage in the admin, in the order you choose.

In this video:
• How Redirect rules, Rewrite rules, rule order and patterns work
• Turning on the URL Rewriting feature
• Redirecting a renamed page and testing the redirect
• Rewriting an address to serve content from another location
• Editing, reordering and deleting rules
